state_custody: Deeply frozen non-Proxy safe projection; private WeakMap retains verified nonissuer immutable records and digest graph, never issuer key/bytes. read input copying and MAC verification finish synchronously before branding. assess uses WeakMap identity without inspecting forged descriptors. Clone/JSON roundtrip returns no callable state authority; no handle can authorize effects.
record_nodes: One node per exact signed canonical whole-file digest; issuer excluded from operation timeline. Nodeclock ordering is same approval boot/source, nondecreasing wall/ns on every edge, <=2000ms elapsed wall/ns disagreement. Missing references and duplicate nodes/phases refuse. Reject cycle using bounded deterministic topological walk; never sort timestamps to invent an order.
edges: Approval < grant2 < ... contiguous grants, with current-grant fence for every other record: namedGrant < record < nextGrant(namedGrant) when successor exists. Intent names grant_sha256, completion names observed_grant_sha256, lease names grant_sha256. This forbids oldgrant use after latergrant even when timestamps tie; old durable lease may remain after a latergrant if its creation precedes it.

Intent < its completion, preceding phase completion < next phase intent; matching predecessor raw digests required. Lease original intent < lease. Completion cannot name a futuregrant; current-grant fence/cycle rejects it.

For each renewal R, completed_before_R is exactly phases excluded from R.remaining_phases; each such completion must exist and completion < R. Every phase included and eventually completed adds R < completion. Missing phases cannot be claimed completed. Included phases remain a suffix of01..04 after the contiguous completed prefix.

R.resumable_intent_sha256 names exactly one existing included-phase intent: intent < R; that intent is not completed before R. Every other included-phase intent adds R < intent. Excluded-phase intent precedes its completion and R. Null means every included-phase intent is after R. At most one uncompleted intent in the final state. References plus renewal fields state a partial order, with cycle rejecting contradictory snapshots.

Referenced grant must permit intent or lease phase and intent/lease creation is strictly before BOTH signed declared expiry bounds, within maximum900000ms. A lease naming renewal must reference the exact resumable original intent. Current samegrant first lease matches original intent nonce/invocation; a distinct owned retry lease identity is not proof of PID/ownership and requires final nativehost checks. Completion may use expired/revoked current observedgrant, because it only settles prior durable outputs.
clock_and_eligibility_clarification: Current observation must be same boot/source and not precede ANY linked record clock, including lease; elapsed wall/ns disagreement<=2000ms to each. Exclude issuer installationclock. Expired immutable history remains valid. No age limit is imposed on storing/reading history. Current grant status expired when observed>=either exact deadline; status revoked if terminal latest eventrevocation. Both are eligibility statuses, not decode failures.

Output precedence: unknown alwaysheld, including completed phases. Existing completion with outputs complete ->completed and original digest; absent/partial-known ->held while retaining its completion digest. No claimed completion repairs deleted/changed outputs or causes another consumption.

For uncompleted requested phase, earlier required completion must exist and no later-phase progress can be bypassed. No intent plus complete/partial ->held. No intent plus absent and live permitted currentgrant ->start. Existing intent plus complete ->settle even expired/revoked; actualhost must independently verify exact outputs/durability. Existing intent absent/partial ->resume only under live originalgrant or live same-scope renewal expressly naming exactintent; otherwiseheld.
Actual lease owner/liveness/recovery, admission, current actual scope/B5, outputs and ordinary effectauthority remain fixed nativehost gates; these pure dispositions establish none of them.
